sources: https://app.fireflyreservations.com/Kiosk/Property/WrayHitchnPost (Firefly engine; quotes for 2027-05-12 and 2027-07-14, one night, 2 adults, Class C motorhome 23 ft, read in the driver browser)

values.note: All RV sites $40 a night for 1-2 people ($5 per extra camper; children 12 and under free); $240 a week (one night free); $650 a month starting on the 1st only. No refunds.

fees.source: https://www.campwraycolorado.com/facility-features-rates ('Pull Through Sites Full Hookups $40/night $240/week (one night FREE!) $650/month available on the 1st'; 'Back In Sites ... $40/night'; 'Additional campers $5/person per night') + Firefly engine (every listed unit '$40.00 avg per night' for May 12-13 2027), read 2026-10-28

hookups.source: https://www.campwraycolorado.com/facility-features-rates ('12 Large pull through stations with water, electricity and sewer hookups'; '4 Back in stations ... 30 amp only'; '4 Back in stations ... 50 amp only'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: 12 full-hookup pull-throughs (30/50 amp) and 8 full-hookup back-ins (T1-T8, four 30 amp, four 50 amp). The engine lists back-ins for rigs up to 40 ft and pull-throughs up to 50 ft. Tent/car camping also offered.

sites.source: https://www.campwraycolorado.com/facility-features-rates (site list above) + Firefly engine ('Fits RVs up to 40 ft' at T1/T5/T6, up to 50 ft at the pull-throughs), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Two private shower rooms and two restrooms; coin laundry 24/7; fiber wifi (busy weekends can be slow); dump station free to overnight campers.

facilities.source: https://www.campwraycolorado.com/facility-features-rates ('Two large and secure shower rooms. Two large and secure restrooms. Coin-Op Washer & Dryer Available 24/7'; 'Free Wi-Fi'; 'On-site RV Dump Station - $10 cash fee at dropbox, FREE for those camping overnight'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Book short stays online (Firefly kiosk) or call/text 970-630-3432, including for a same-night space. Stays of a month or longer by phone only. Self check-in envelopes in the off season (November-April).

booking.source: https://www.campwraycolorado.com/ ('Click here to be taken to our Firefly Reservation kiosk'; 'Only short term spaces are available on the kiosk so please call or text us to discuss long term camping'; 'TEXT us to get a quick availability and rate check'; Off Season Hours November-April 'We kindly request the use of self check in envelopes'), read 2026-10-28

discounts.source: https://www.campwraycolorado.com/facility-features-rates ('10% Military discount available w/valid military ID'), read 2026-10-28

note: Family-run, tree-lined RV park on the south hill just outside Wray, off US-385. Long-term spaces also rented. Not on the water (Stalker Lake and Sandsage Wildlife Area are nearby). --Claude
summary: Operator site + Firefly engine: confirmed $40 (engine quotes $40 for May 2027), full hookups, pull-throughs, laundry, wifi, dump, online booking; added electric 50 (30 and 50 amp sites), 20 RV sites (12 pull-through, 8 back-in), max 50 ft, showers, flush toilets, military 10%, Firefly URL. Season year_round left (off-season hours November-April imply year-round operation). Note trimmed of hookup/amenity/booking restatements.
flags: Long-stay five tests (stored 'transient and long-term'): (1) no seasonal-only sites; (2) nightly price posted ($40) and sold online; (3) no homes or lots for sale (a house on the property is rented to an unrelated tenant); (4) the engine offered 8 of the 20 RV sites for one night in May 2027 (well over 1 in 10), though none for July 14 2027; (5) short stays need no approval - only month-plus stays go by phone. Passes; a transient park that also rents monthly ($650 from the 1st).
US$50 gate: $40 a night (posted and engine quote, May 2027). Passes. Nearest gateway Denver 238 km; the family has not stayed here.
Presence: operator website with phone 970-630-3432 and a working Firefly engine. Passes.
Engine rig types: Firefly asks for equipment type and offers Motorhome Class A/B/C; quoted as Class C 23 ft. No van-only class.
Engine detail: site T8 is listed as '50 AMP BACK IN - WATER & ELECTRICITY' (no sewer) though the rates page says all eight back-ins have sewer; immaterial to the group values.
Phone 970-630-3432 and website match. Ownership private correct; waterfront 'not waterfront' correct.
